docs/extensions.md:86:- pi-action installs the extensions after its coding tools (read, write, edit, bash). Each extension must have a unique name, other than `coding-tools` and `pi-action`. Tool names can repeat (see [Override tools and sections](#override-tools-and-sections)).
docs/extensions.md:92:- **Replace a tool.** A tool with the name of an earlier tool replaces it, as `pi.registerTool` does in pi. For example, an extension with its own `bash` tool replaces the `bash` of pi-action. pi-action writes `pi-durable extension <name> replaces tool bash from coding-tools` to the log.
docs/extensions.md:95:The order is: the coding tools of pi-action (`coding-tools`) first, then its built-in extension `pi-action`, then the extensions in the order of the `extensions` input. Extensions cannot use the names `coding-tools` and `pi-action`. pi-durable applies the wraps of all extensions in this order. Thus, the last wrap wins.
docs/extensions.md:101:`createPiDurableExtension` receives `{ cwd, agentDir, trustProject, ui, log, images }`:
docs/extensions.md:110:| `images` | An image processor, `createNodePhotonImages()` of pi-durable. It resizes and converts images to the limits of the model, for example for pit's `workspace.viewImage` (pit 0.36.2 and later) |
README.md:93:| `model_input` | Comma-separated input types of the custom model (`text` or `text,image`) | No | `text` |
The order is: the coding tools of pi-action (`coding-tools`) first, then its built-in extension `pi-action`, then the extensions in the order of the `extensions` input. Extensions cannot use the names `coding-tools` and `pi-action`. pi-durable applies the wraps of all extensions in this order. Thus, the last wrap wins.

The `pi-action` extension has pi's system prompt sections. Use these keys with `wrapSection`: `preamble`, `tools`, `rules`, `addendum`, `project_context`, `available_skills`, and `cwd` (see [The system prompt](prompts.md#the-system-prompt)). For example, `wrapSection("rules", (s) => ({ ...s, render: () => "- My rule" }))` replaces pi's rules.

### Host options

`createPiDurableExtension` receives `{ cwd, agentDir, trustProject, ui, log, images }`:

| Option | Value |
|--------|-------|
| `cwd` | The workspace |
| `agentDir` | `agent_dir`, resolved against the workspace. If `agent_dir` is empty: a new temporary directory in `RUNNER_TEMP` |
| `trustProject` | The `trust_project` input |
| `ui` | `{ ask, notify }`, the GitHub UI (see [Questions on GitHub](#questions-on-github)). Only in `comment` mode on an issue or pull request. Not set in `output` mode or for direct prompts |
| `log` | The log of the action (`info`, `warning`) |
| `images` | An image processor, `createNodePhotonImages()` of pi-durable. It resizes and converts images to the limits of the model, for example for pit's `workspace.viewImage` (pit 0.36.2 and later) |

pi-durable extensions run in the process of pi-action. Thus, pi-action also sets `GH_TOKEN` and the git identity in its own environment when it loads such an extension. See [Security](security.md#the-agents-github-token-and-git-identity).

### Show tool calls in the workflow log
